text:
marta: heads up — found a pretty nasty edge with the python async client and retries. when a per-request deadline is set, it doesn't get propagated down to the transport/backoff layer, so a long backoff can outlive the caller deadline and we end up replaying the request after the caller already timed out. this caused duplicate resource creates in a customer test.

sam: ouch. can you paste a minimal repro? is this with the new async client or legacy?

marta: async client, 0.8.3. repro:

```
async with client as c:
    await c.create_object(payload, timeout=0.8, idempotency_key=gen_key())
```

The user-visible timeout/cancel happens but under the hood the retry/backoff loop keeps trying until the transport finishes its own retry window. idempotency_key is generated and sent late (after body prepared), so the subsequent replay doesn't always include the same key in a few code paths.

aj: hmm, timeline makes sense. if the deadline isn't passed into the retry loop, the retry loop will treat the request as transient and keep trying. two problems: deadline propagation and early-binding of idempotency header.

sam: can confirm re: early-binding — in our sync client we bind idempotency header before starting the request body streaming, but async code path deferred it until after chunking starts. likely a bug in the request-prep hook for streams.

marta: exact. simple fix locally: generate idempotency key and attach header in user code before calling; that mitigates dupes but it's ugly and not documented.

ryan: sounds like a feature + bug. feature: allow a per-request \"deadline\" param that is enforced across transport and retry loop (not just socket read timeout). bug: ensure idempotency header binding happens synchronously before any await that yields to the event loop.

sam: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/789 — adds Deadline object and passes it to RetryPolicy and Transport. still failing a flaky test in streaming harness. dev-bot: CI: streaming-harness (flake) failed — see logs.

dev-bot: [ci] streaming-harness failed on py38-async with error \"BrokenPipeError\" — full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/streams/4321/logs

aj: for immediate mitigation we can: 1) document recommended pattern (generate idempotency_key before call, set header manually), 2) add a guard in transport to refuse retry for requests flagged non-idempotent, and 3) add deadline propagation RFC for the SDK.

marta: +1 on RFC. for (2) we need an ergonomic way for users to mark a call non-replayable. maybe param `allow_replay=False` or `idempotency_key=None` semantics?

ryan: I'd prefer explicit param `allow_replay=True/False` because relying on idempotency header presence is brittle when headers are added later by middleware. default True for backward compat.

sam: tradeoff: many users expect retries on 5xx. forcing them to add allow_replay=False will be noisy. maybe default True but the transport should stop if deadline reached (honor caller cancel) — that would reduce dupes without API churn.

marta: agreed but still want early idempotency binding so service-sided dedupe works reliably. we should also add a test harness that simulates deadline cancel vs transport backoff to prevent regressions.

aj: I'll sketch a test: fake server returns 502 twice with delay, then 200. test asserts the server saw only one create request when idempotency header set before call, and sees multiple when header is bound late. can push as unit test.

ryan: typing/typing note — our current AsyncClient.send signature has `timeout: Optional[float]` and `**kwargs`. proposing: `deadline: Optional[datetime.timedelta] | float | None` with pydantic/typing docs and clear semantics. we should update stubs.

marta: +1. also call out how `timeout` vs `deadline` differ: timeout is per-socket/read, deadline is total time for entire operation including retries.

sam: for backwards compat, implement `deadline` but keep `timeout` as alias for socket-level. Add deprecation note in changelog.

marta: will file a DX ticket for onboarding docs: show recommended idempotency pattern and the new deadline API example. customers hit this during PoC so docs need to be clear.

ryan: thanks — next steps: sam finalizes PR to propagate Deadline to RetryPolicy, aj adds idempotency early-bind tests, and marta writes the docs. I'll shepherd typing update and release note.

marta: thanks all. one follow-up: can someone add a short snippet for the workaround to the SDK README so support can share it?

sam: will add a short block under \"Retry & Idempotency\" showing how to prebind the header and a note about upcoming RFC.

marta: awesome. :thumbsup:

aj: leaving a quick checklist here:
- [ ] propagate deadline into retry loop
- [ ] ensure idempotency header bound synchronously in async path
- [ ] add unit test that simulates deadline vs retry replay
- [ ] docs/snippet for workaround
- [ ] update typing for deadline arg

ryan: nice checklist. marking this for the SDK sprint board.

marta: saved — thanks everyone.
